property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the contract stores the provided _changeFee into the public changeFee state variable (i.e. c.changeFee() == _changeFee); the mutant sets changeFee to 0 instead, so it violates this when _changeFee != 0.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to a constant 0, altering stored value.
